title: Users
intro: Create accounts for students, trainers and administrators, and deactivate accounts that should no longer sign in.
search: Search by name, email, roll number or employee code
caption: User accounts

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.body: Only an account with no activity yet (for example one created by mistake) can be deleted, and this cannot be undone. Accounts with history can only be deactivated.

resetPassword.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
resetPassword.body: Type a new password and share it with {{name}} privately. They are signed out everywhere, and a locked account is unlocked.
resetPassword.tooShort: Use at least {{min}} characters, with a letter and a digit

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
confirmDeactivate.body: They will be signed out everywhere and will not be able to sign in until reactivated. Their records are kept.

form.title: Add user
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with a letter and a digit. Share it with the user privately.
form.mustChangePassword: Ask them to choose their own password at first sign-in
